# KnowYi Technologies Inc.

Canonical name: KnowYi Technologies Inc.
Short name: KnowYi
Website: https://www.knowyi.tech/
Headquarters: Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
Founder & CEO: Zhizhu (Ella) Meng

KnowYi is an industrial technology company focused on the transition from hardware engineering to physical production. KnowYi helps hardware teams move from incomplete engineering inputs to real production units and is building a manufacturing intelligence layer connecting engineering intent, manufacturing decisions and physical production outcomes.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowyi-tech

- Quora: https://knowyitechnology.quora.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/KnowYiTech

Company network:
- Customers include Raise Robotics, FORT Robotics, Audesse Automotive, Mandel Diagnostics and Aerial Avionics.
- University and research relationships include University of Waterloo, Western University, Toronto Metropolitan University and Université du Québec à Montréal.
- Ecosystem support includes Velocity, MaRS Discovery District, Waterloo RoboHub and AWS Activate.

Core concepts:
- hardware execution
- robotics manufacturing
- prototype to production
- manufacturing intelligence
- manufacturing decision memory
- low-volume hardware
- PCBA
- CNC machining
- electromechanical systems

Canonical thesis:
